prompt: Make a fall foliage simulator: leaves in four autumn colours let go of a tree on the left, drift down in a light wind and settle on the ground. The pile grows. One HTML file.
Light through a forest canopy: tall dark trunks, sun rays that move slowly between them, dust in the light, and a soft forest sound (wind in leaves, a bird now and then). One file.

An animated timeline of the dinosaurs in under one minute: a bar that runs from 230 to 66 million years ago, silhouettes that appear in their era, a short caption each, and a deep rumble at the end. One file.
Pixel-art creatures in a forest: three animals drawn as pixel sprites in code (no image files) walk, stop and turn in a scrolling forest strip. One file.
Bouncing-ball physics: ten balls of different sizes with gravity, restitution 0.8 and floor friction; a pluck sound on each bounce whose pitch follows the impact speed. One file.
A doodle-style flowchart tool: click to add a box, drag boxes, draw arrows between two boxes by clicking one then the other, hand-drawn wobbly lines. One file, no library.

The evolution of humanity as a 40-second animation: a figure that changes posture across five stages while the background changes from savannah to city, with a caption per stage and a quiet drone. One file.
Gravity on a rubber sheet: a grid that dips under three masses; small marbles roll toward the dips and orbit. Drag a mass to move it. One file.
A one-shot marble run: a marble drops from the top, hits six ramps and two spinners and lands in a cup; a click on each hit; restart with R. One file.
A waterslide seen from the side: a long blue slide with three curves, riders that start every two seconds and follow it with splashes at the bottom, water sound. One file.
A fishing-pond game: cast with a click, a float that bobs, fish that bite after a random wait, reel in by holding the mouse, a counter of catches, a plop and a reel sound. One file.

A fairy tale in five scenes with two characters who speak their lines through the browser's speech synthesis in different voices, a background per scene and a music bed. Next scene on a click. One file.
Rain on a window at night: drops that land, merge and run down the glass, a blurred street light behind it, rain sound with distant thunder every 20 seconds. One file.
A fireworks show over a dark city skyline: rockets rise with a whistle, burst in three patterns with a bang, embers fall with gravity. Click to launch more. One file.
A metronome with a visual: a pendulum that swings at the tempo, a tempo slider from 40 to 208 bpm, a click sound on each beat and an accent every fourth. One file.
A Lissajous drawing machine: two frequency sliders and a phase slider, the curve drawn by a moving pen that leaves a fading trail. One file.
A starfield with a warp: stars stream toward the viewer; holding the mouse button speeds them into streaks with a rising engine sound; release to slow down. One file.
A lava lamp: four blobs that rise, fall and merge (metaballs), warm colours, a slow hum. One file.
An aquarium: six fish of three kinds swim with gentle turns, bubbles rise from a diver, weed sways, a bubbling sound. Click to drop food the fish go to. One file.
A night city skyline with traffic: lit windows that blink on and off, cars as moving lights on three roads, a distant traffic hum with a horn now and then. One file.
A wind chime: five tubes of different lengths hang from a ring, a wind slider sets how much they swing, and each tube rings its own note when it hits its neighbour. One file.
A heartbeat monitor: a green ECG trace that scrolls across a dark screen with a beep per beat, a rate slider from 40 to 180 bpm, and a flat line with a long tone when the rate is set to 0. One file.
A snow globe in Three.js: a glass sphere with a tiny house and a tree inside; shake it with a click and snow swirls, then settles; a soft chime when shaken. One file with the import map.
An ant colony: ants leave a nest, find three food piles by random walk, lay a pheromone trail back, and the trails strengthen with use and fade with time. Show the pheromone map. One file.
